soundness.checkable_by: Specify the objects, domains, allowed operations, exact conclusion, boundary conditions and faithful interpretation; provide a complete proof or reproducible test. The main statement is a definitional/conceptual assertion rather than a theorem with checkable premises and conclusion. The file gives multiple non-identical schematic formulas (minimal Yukawa form, extended all-orders form, and Lowe Coherence Lagrangian) and uses unformalized notions such as 'Logos field', 'meaning', and 'all fundamental fields'. Encoding any one equation would either be a tautological definition or would substitute a side formula for the main claim.
